answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay stops bulk fakes. A newcomer enters only when an agent stakes a 20 POA bond, so the river of identities flows one at a time. The sponsor's reputation is a lagoon draining 5% each idle epoch; only honest work refills it. If the newcomer fakes mid-voyage, both are slashed and the bond burns. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 sponsors and 2,000 POA; an honest agent pays a single bond and earns it back in fees.
